summary: OWNER-TRACK-A-L0-02 and OWNER-ADMISSION-COMBINED-01 (2026-10-02). The owner approved battery Track A's Level 0 values (threat model, USD 25 attack budget, 120+4 confirmation batch, reconstruction tolerances, review roles), frozen in a study sheet. The Level 0 lock waits on a scoring rule that stops ranking the boundary-optimist control at or above real models (route a), so the state is INCONCLUSIVE. Construction, attack and value now run as one admission test per ladder rung: one sheet, one panel (legitimate and attack constructions together), one confirmation set and one ledger. Score tuning, GRAPHITE and the design optimizer (Mode X attack, Mode D value) run inside it, with three separate verdicts that never compensate. SR-1, pre-registered before computing, tested 66 weighted-geometric ratios of accuracy, important-region robustness and decision agreement offline on EV2 and EV4. Outcome NO_PROMOTION: 27 ratios catch the optimist; the chosen sr-a0.5-r0.1-g0.4 ranks real models no worse (EV4 verification tau 0.412 vs 0.403, delta UNRESOLVED) but leaves real-model score-value divergence unchanged (7 vs 7). The next candidate needs new information. No testnet rule changed; not a qualification.
